caption: The drawing depicts a wooden covered wagon with four large spoked wheels, two at the front and two at the rear, attached to a wooden frame and axles. The wagon's body is constructed of horizontal wooden planks, with vertical wooden supports spaced evenly along its sides. The top of the wagon is covered by a beige or light tan canvas, which is draped in an arched shape over a series of curved bows forming the roof. The canvas appears wrinkled and is fastened to the wooden frame. The front of the wagon features two wooden shafts extending outward, likely used for harnessing to animals. Metal hardware, such as bolts, brackets, and chains, is visible on various parts of the wagon for structural support and reinforcement. The overall color scheme consists of natural wood grays and browns, muted by aging, and the faded tan of the canvas top, all set against a plain off-white background.
title: Conestoga Wagon
